page.title: Let Sarah learn your business
page.subtitle: Sarah reads what already exists online, asks only what she can't find, and proves she's ready before taking real calls.
page.loadError: We couldn't load your setup. Please refresh and try again.
page.noPermission: You don't have permission to set up the business profile.

sources.heading: Where should Sarah look?
sources.websiteHelp: Only your own website. Sarah follows robots.txt and reads a handful of public pages.
sources.pastePlaceholder: Paste your price list, service list or any notes. Prices are only used if they appear here or on your site.
sources.pasteHelp: Up to about 3,500 characters. Uploading PDFs and photos is not available yet.
sources.ownConfirm: This website and text belong to my business.
sources.needInput: Add your website or paste some text first.
sources.needConfirm: Please confirm the content belongs to your business.
sources.blocked: Skipped: the site asks automated tools not to read it
sources.noFields: Sarah couldn't find usable facts. You can still continue with the interview.
sources.privacyNote: Page text is never stored. We keep what Sarah learned, with the quote that proves it. You can delete it any time.

interview.heading: A few quick questions
interview.intro: Sarah only asks about what she couldn't confirm. Answer by typing or with your voice, or skip.
interview.micUnsupported: Voice input isn't supported in this browser. Type your answer instead.
interview.micError: The microphone isn't available. Type your answer instead.

review.heading: Review what Sarah learned
review.intro: Everything in one place. Prices, emergency rules and legal claims need your explicit approval before anything goes live.
review.invalid: That doesn't look right. Check the format hint.

hint.hours: One day per line, like: mon 08:00-17:00
hint.faq: Q: question, then a new line starting with A: answer. Separate items with a blank line
hint.emergency: yes_premium, yes_same_rate, business_hours_only or unknown, then an optional note after a colon

review.empty: Nothing learned yet. Go back and add a source or answer the interview.
review.deleteRun: Delete this run and everything it learned
review.deleteConfirm: Delete everything Sarah learned in this run? Details already published to your profile stay.

readiness.heading: Prove Sarah is ready
readiness.intro: Sarah handles 20 realistic calls built from your profile: a 2 a.m. emergency, a price shopper, a wrong-trade request, an angry caller and more. Nothing is dialled or booked.
readiness.needed: Go-live needs at least 85% and no failures in safety-critical calls.
readiness.gateFail: Not ready yet. Fix the items below, then run again.
readiness.error: The test calls could not run. Please try again.
readiness.testBody: Call Sarah yourself with your profile, then confirm it sounded right.
readiness.testError: The test call could not connect.

blockers.required_missing: Approve business name, services and service area.
blockers.sensitive_pending: Approve or reject every sensitive item.

readiness.goLiveError: We couldn't go live. Please try again.

live.heading: Sarah is live
live.body: Your approved profile is now what Sarah uses on calls.

suggestions.heading: Sarah learned something new
suggestions.intro: Callers asked these questions and Sarah had no answer.
